data.revised_prompt:
Create a polished single PNG sprite sheet for a 2D game emitted attack FX animation, using the provided Caesar / Boss K avatar only as visual identity reference (deep royal blue dragon energy, icy cyan flame edges, white-blue highlights, gold antler-crown accents, pearly core, regal final-boss mood) and the provided 2x4 guide only as invisible layout reference. Canvas is a wide 2 rows x 4 columns sprite sheet with 8 equal wide frame slots read left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Background must be pure solid flat chroma-key magenta #FF00FF everywhere between and around frames. NO visible grid lines, NO frame borders, NO labels, NO text, NO numbers, NO letters, NO UI, NO watermark, NO guide marks, NO boxes, NO safe rectangles. Each FX centered in its invisible cell with generous magenta padding; nothing touches or crosses cell edges; consistent scale.

Subject: FX-only projectile emitted attack after Caesar / Boss K attacks, travelling horizontally left-to-right. Not an aura, not a shield, not a circular sigil, not character pose. No avatar, no face, no body, no hands. Compact directional blue dragonfire lance / claw wave called “Caesar Royal Seizure Lance”. Clean HD pixel-inspired RPG battle sprite FX, crisp readable silhouette, transparent-ready edges, saturated aquatic fantasy palette. Deep royal blue and electric cyan dragonfire, white-hot leading edge, black-navy inner shadows, small gold antler-crown sparks, pearly orb glints, sharp final-boss geometry. Abstract blank card shards only, blue/white, no ranks, no letters, no numbers, no suit symbols, no full card faces.

Frame details in 2x4 layout:
1 top-left: small blue-white pearl spark just launched, slightly left of center, tiny gold crown flecks behind it, strong rightward motion.
2 top-second: spark stretches into short cyan comet with dark royal-blue core moving right, small gold flecks trailing left.
3 top-third: narrow dragonfire fang, white-hot tip on right, blue flame tail on left, sharp icy edges.
4 top-right: gold antler-crown arc and two abstract blank blue card shards spiral into wake, projectile still moving right, no symbols.
5 bottom-left: peak form long diagonal-forward royal-blue lance, sharp white leading edge, claw-like cyan flame along top and bottom, black-navy inner shadows, regal dangerous silhouette.
6 bottom-second: impact-ready wave, lance widens slightly into crescent slash, blank card shards trail behind, no circular shield.
7 bottom-third: energy breaking apart into blue flame ribbons and gold sparks, forward motion still clear, fragments grouped along projectile path.
8 bottom-right: dissipation, small cyan embers and fading pearl streak, mostly empty magenta space, loop-ready.

Quality: polished clean HD pixel-inspired sprite sheet asset, sharp details and clean edges, consistent emitted attack identity across all 8 frames, strong left-to-right directionality in every frame, no smoke cloud filling cells, no black background, particles fully inside each cell.
